name: Touhikou Game
source:
One day during class, Akito gazed outside the window and mumbled to himself: “… I want to run away somewhere”. “That sounds good, where shall we go?”. He was surprised by the response and looked over to see his classmate in the neighbouring seat smiling at him. He had never talked to her before, but those words made him want to attain his hidden wishes.

His life changed greatly from that day on. He met a strange girl Nia who seemed to be chased by someone in an alley, was approached by a foreigner Norm who took a liking to him, made friends with a traveler Korone who was passing by on a trip, and was closely monitored by his imouto Mirika who thought he was acting suspicious lately. Thanks to this ‘running away game’ which his classmate Renna had proposed, there are no more boring days. However, he still had a wish to find someone who he loves and run away together to somewhere far away.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一天上课时，秋人望着窗外，自言自语道：“……我想逃到某个地方。”
“听起来不错。我们要去哪里？”
他惊讶地回过头，看见邻座的同学正朝自己微笑。他以前从未和她说过话，但这几句话让他想要实现藏在心底的愿望。

从那天起，他的生活发生了巨大变化。他在小巷里遇见了一个似乎正被人追赶的神秘女孩妮娅；一个喜欢上他的外国人诺姆主动接近他；他与旅行途中经过此地的旅行者科隆成了朋友；而认为他最近表现可疑的妹妹米莉卡则一直紧盯着他。多亏同学蕾娜提出的“逃跑游戏”，无聊的日子一去不复返。但他仍有一个愿望：找到自己爱的人，一起逃到遥远的地方。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
